# Vendored dependencies and geographic dataset

- OpenFX C API header files: AcademySoftwareFoundation/openfx, BSD-3-Clause, from project upstream (2026-11-05). https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openfx . Headers retain SPDX and copyright.
- json11: Dropbox/json11, MIT. Copyright (c) 2013 Dropbox, Inc. https://github.com/dropbox/json11. License text retained in json11.cpp.
- Countries data: copied from original CartoRig with the accompanying countryinfo license text; attribution and caveats are in data/LICENSE-COUNTRYINFO.txt. Boundaries are schematic and are not legal statements.

No SDK binaries from Blackmagic are redistributed.
